usage: agentware dream [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--dry-run] [--steps a,b,…]
                       [--force] [--install-schedule] [--uninstall-schedule]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --dry-run             report the ordered step plan; mutate NOTHING
  --steps a,b,…         run only this comma-separated subset of steps a-f (a
                        index-rebuild, b bench-redact, c audit, d eval-record,
                        e detect-report, f kb-git-commit)
  --force               bypass the idle-gate for a manual run (the concurrency
                        lock is STILL honored)
  --install-schedule    install the nightly schedule into HOME (launchd/cron)
                        — requires dream ON + a configured --set-dream-
                        schedule
  --uninstall-schedule  remove an installed nightly schedule (idempotent)
